Apple TV has confirmed the premiere date of Nocturne, an upcoming drama series starring Liev Schreiber (Spotlight), Zazie Beetz (They Will Kill You), and Stephen Graham (Adolescence). Here are the details.

Nocturne premieres October 30

In a post published on X, Apple TV confirmed that Nocturne (previously known as Lazarus) will premiere on October 30.

The platform also published two first-look images showcasing the main cast, in addition to the show’s synopsis:

How do you beat a serial killer at his own game?

When the victim of a notorious killer unexpectedly turns up alive, a detective races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

As noted by Deadline, Nocturne is based on two novels by Lars Kepler: Lazarus, and The Sandman. Rowan Joffe created the project and will serve as an executive producer, while John Hlavin, who developed the 10-episode adaptation, will serve as showrunner, writer, and executive producer.
